notes.title: KICKSTARTER UPDATE!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey everyone! 

Our Kickstarter campaign has ended (if you can believe 30 days have already flown by!) and although this first attempt didn't meet the monetary goal, we view this as a tremendous success overall. We're incredibly thankful to every single one of you who backed, shared, or simply believed in Metaparks at this early stage! 

Apart from fundraising to bolster resources for our growing team, our other objectives were to announce the existence of the project to our community, and to measure tangible player interest- which is clearly evident to say the least! 

That said, we'd still love to honor the rewards for those who pledged as a thank you for backing the project. If you pledged any amount to the project, please complete this Google Form when you have a chance and we'll make sure you receive your rewards when the time comes: [/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/s4gAcfDApLYHAjnm9"]https://forms.gle/s4gAcfDApLYHAjnm9[/url][/p][p]
Metaparks is currently moving full steam ahead, and we'll continue developing the project and pursuing alternative fundraising efforts as we always have. 

We cannot wait to hop in there with everyone, and going forward we're even more excited for you to come along for the ride  Thanks again everyone, [/p][p]
[b]You can check out our kickstarter here![/b] [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/metaparks/metaparks-the-theme-park-game-weve-all-been-waiting-for/comments" buttoncolor="#05ce78"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/metaparks/[/url]     

You joined us at the very beginning of our journey, and we’re dedicated to maintaining a transparent, community-driven development process. We’re a passionate, albeit small team that has diligently worked to reach our pre-MVP first playable milestone. For any questions or news, please hop on over to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/v9kD2HaX6V"]Discord[/url]. 


Together with a community member, Nerdchacho, we took a deep dive into the current version of the game and have answered many of the questions you guys have been asking so far! The Q&A covers a wide range of different topics — from gameplay features and future plans to behind-the-scenes development footage and insights. 

[url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dXglBy54jTc"]Metaparks: First Gameplay Footage and Your Questions Answered: Interview With A Dev[/url]

[/p][p]Please continue spreading the word and of course share some love on Nerdchacho's channel for his time and this amazing interview.
We thank each and everyone for your support. This has been an unforgettable journey!   [/p]
